title: Data Residency
summary: Rules about where personal/regulated data may be stored and processed.
explain: Residency is not language localization. Replicating EU PII to a US analytics store without approval can violate policy/law. Designs need data-flow diagrams, region-aware storage, and pipeline gates.
analogy: You can't move vault contents to another country because the chart looks prettier there.
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Data Residency” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Data → mechanism → failure)

Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Data Residency” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
